unnerved.speaker: lattice_archivist
unnerved.text: There is a dead thing in my enclave. It is not indexed. Is it yours?

choices.text: [Hollow] Index me, then, Archivist. Start with the date I died.
It is with me. That is the whole entry.

report.speaker: lattice_archivist
report.text: The leak. Sealed, your log says. The Index does not take logs on trust; it takes them on file. Filed. Now: the Key. The Lattice has indexed where one sits: under the Ghost Markets, in the echo where the Choir keeps its ledgers.

choices.text: [Corporate] Tal. I was an asset once. Which of us is filing whom?
Then that is where we go.
Whisper wants a word with you, Archivist.

tal_whisper.speaker: whisper
tal_whisper.text: Tal. You have been calling my line home to be wiped. I am home. I am not wiped. Stop calling.

choices.text: You heard her. Stop the recall.
The Archivist and I have business first.

done.speaker: lattice_archivist
done.text: Filed. The Markets, Weaver. Do not lose the Key in the noise.

early.speaker: lattice_archivist
early.text: The leak first. The Index does not skip lines.

keys.speaker: lattice_archivist
keys.text: The Key of the Ledgers is filed as resolved. The Index has moved the Loom from rumour to location. I do not like where the location is.

choices.text: Then file where we go next.

loom.speaker: lattice_archivist
loom.text: The Beacon on the plaza did what the Index said it could not. I have amended the Index. Go down, Weaver; the enclave will keep the shelves.
